papers.title: Effect of surface micro-pits on mode-II fracture toughness of Ti-6Al-4V/PEEK interface

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ti-6Al-4V/PEEK界面的断裂韧性，与多孔结构应力遮挡或疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on interfacial fracture toughness of a Ti-6Al-4V/PEEK composite, not on porous implant design, stress shielding, LPBF fabrication, or fatigue testing of biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究表面微坑对Ti-6Al-4V/PEEK界面断裂韧性的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备不同微坑密度的Ti-6Al-4V表面，与PEEK热压复合后进行端部缺口弯曲试验
summary_zh.result: 微坑密度增加提高了界面断裂韧性，但存在最优密度
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证了微坑对界面韧性的增强效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of surface micro-pits on the mode-II fracture toughness of Ti-6Al-4V/PEEK interface.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V surfaces with varying micro-pit densities were fabricated and bonded with PEEK via hot pressing, followed by end-notched flexure tests.
summary_en.result: Increasing micro-pit density enhanced interfacial fracture toughness up to an optimal density.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing validated the toughening effect of micro-pits.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Anesthesiology and Perioperative Medicine, Mayo Clinic, Jacksonville, FL

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究氨甲环酸在关节置换术中的并发症风险，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物设计内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical study on tranexamic acid safety in arthroplasty; it does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical analysis of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估氨甲环酸在高危患者关节置换术中的安全性。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性病例对照研究，分析38220例患者数据。
summary_zh.result: 氨甲环酸不增加并发症风险。
summary_zh.validation: 大规模临床数据统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the safety of tranexamic acid in high-risk patients undergoing total knee or hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective case-control study analyzing data from 38,220 patients.
summary_en.result: Tranexamic acid administration was not associated with increased complications.

papers.title: Implant Survival of Constrained Acetabular Device in Primary Total Hip Arthroplasty Based on Data From the Finnish Arthroplasty Register
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Constrained acetabular devices were developed to prevent dislocations after total hip arthroplasty (THA). However, the data on their success have been contradictory. In this study, we aimed to assess implant survival of the constrained acetabular device in primary THA based on the Finnish Arthroplasty Register data. METHODS: A total of 373 primary THAs with constrained acetabular devices inserted from 2006 to 2017 were included. A reference group was formed on a 1:3 basis and matched for age, sex, and diagnosis, consisting of 1118 conventional THAs. Implant survival estimates using death as a competing risk were assessed with revision for any reason and for any aseptic reason as the endpoints. The Cox multiple regression models were adjusted for age, sex, and diagnosis. The mean follow-up time was 3.3 (0-12.4) years for the constrained device group and 3.8 (0-12.0) years for the reference group. RESULTS: Overall, there were 21 revisions in the constrained device group and 49 in the reference group. The 8-year survivorship for any reason was 94% (confidence interval [CI]: 91-96) for the constrained device group and 93% (CI: 89-97) for the reference group. With revision for any aseptic reason as the endpoint, the 8-year survivorships were 97% (CI: 95-99) and 94% (CI: 90-98), respectively. During the first 1.5 years, the constrained acetabular device group had a similar revision risk (hazard ratio: 1.09 [CI: 0.57-2.07], P = .8) to that of the reference group. CONCLUSION: The constrained acetabular device had good survival in primary THA, and our results support its continued use even in high-risk patients.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注髋臼约束装置在初次全髋关节置换术中的存活率，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或生物力学建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any biomechanical modeling; it is a clinical registry study on acetabular component survival only.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估约束型髋臼假体在初次全髋置换中的存活率。
summary_zh.method: 基于芬兰关节置换登记数据，匹配对照分析373例约束型假体与1118例常规假体。
summary_zh.result: 约束型假体8年存活率94%，与常规假体无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床登记数据生存分析，竞争风险模型。

summary_en.motivation: To assess the survival of constrained acetabular devices in primary total hip arthroplasty using registry data.
summary_en.method: A matched cohort study of 373 constrained and 1118 conventional THAs from the Finnish Arthroplasty Register with competing risk survival analysis.
summary_en.result: The constrained device showed 94% 8-year survival, comparable to conventional implants.
summary_en.validation: Clinical registry data with Cox regression and competing risk models.
